evidence.text: RealityCheck demo: simulated analytics initialization failure

remediation.summary: Handle optional analytics initialization without emitting a production console error.
technicalHints: Use a recoverable warning or feature-state result for an optional integration.

reproductionSteps: Open the demo in a clean desktop browser context.
Observe the first console error emitted after navigation.
findings.summary: A console error is emitted during the baseline load before any stress scenario runs.
findings.title: The page logs an initialization error

remediation.summary: 处理可选分析服务的初始化失败，不要在生产控制台中输出错误。
technicalHints: 对于可选集成，使用可恢复的警告或明确的功能状态结果。

reproductionSteps: 在干净的桌面浏览器上下文中打开演示页。
观察页面导航后的第一条控制台错误。
zh-CN.summary: 在运行任何压力场景之前，基线加载过程就产生了一条控制台错误。
zh-CN.title: 页面在初始化时输出错误

remediation.summary: Remove the fixed minimum shell width and stack the hero actions at the mobile breakpoint.
technicalHints: Replace min-width: 1040px with responsive grid constraints.
Allow the primary action to wrap below the heading on narrow screens.

reproductionSteps: Open the demo at a 375x812 viewport.
Observe that the Start checkout review button is outside the initial viewport.
findings.summary: The fixed 1040px application shell places the primary checkout action beyond the 375px viewport.
findings.title: Checkout review is outside the mobile viewport

remediation.summary: 移除应用外壳的固定最小宽度，并在手机断点把主操作排列到标题下方。
technicalHints: 用响应式网格约束替换 min-width: 1040px。
在窄屏上允许主要操作换行到标题下方。

reproductionSteps: 使用 375×812 的视口打开演示页。
确认“开始结账审核”按钮不在初始视口内。
zh-CN.summary: 应用外壳固定为 1040px 宽，使主要结账审核按钮落在 375px 手机视口之外。
zh-CN.title: 移动端视口内无法看到结账审核按钮

evidence.text: 超长客户名称：上海现实检查与可靠性工程联合实验室

remediation.summary: Expose the full customer name while preserving the card layout.
technicalHints: Allow wrapping or add an accessible expansion/tooltip mechanism.

reproductionSteps: Run the long-text scenario with seed 42.
Inspect the priority customer name in the Review required panel.
findings.summary: The customer name exceeds its fixed width and is hidden with ellipsis after deterministic long-text injection.
findings.title: Long customer names are clipped without access to the full value

remediation.summary: 在保持卡片布局的同时，让用户能够访问完整客户名称。
technicalHints: 允许名称换行，或增加支持键盘和读屏器的展开/提示机制。

reproductionSteps: 使用种子 42 运行长文本场景。
检查“需要审核”面板中的重点客户名称。
zh-CN.summary: 注入确定性的长文本后，客户名称超过固定宽度，并被省略号隐藏。
zh-CN.title: 超长客户名称被截断，用户无法访问完整内容

remediation.summary: Use logical spacing so status alignment follows writing direction.
technicalHints: Replace margin-left: auto with margin-inline-start: auto.

reproductionSteps: Set html dir=rtl and lang=ar in a fresh context.
Inspect the alignment of status chips in panel headers.
findings.summary: The status chip uses margin-left instead of a logical property and does not mirror with document direction.
findings.title: Status alignment remains pinned to the physical right side

remediation.summary: 使用逻辑方向的间距属性，使状态标签跟随书写方向对齐。
technicalHints: 将 margin-left: auto 替换为 margin-inline-start: auto。

reproductionSteps: 在新的浏览器上下文中设置 html dir=rtl 和 lang=ar。
检查面板标题中状态标签的对齐方式。
zh-CN.summary: 状态标签使用 margin-left 而不是逻辑属性，因此页面切换书写方向后没有正确镜像。
zh-CN.title: 状态标签仍固定在物理右侧

remediation.summary: Declare the avatar decorative or provide a concise alternative.
technicalHints: Use alt="" when the adjacent customer name already conveys the same information.

reproductionSteps: Open the demo and inspect the priority customer avatar.
Abort image requests and confirm that no alt text is available.
findings.summary: When the image fails, no alternative text identifies whether the image is decorative or meaningful.
findings.title: The customer avatar has no text alternative

remediation.summary: 明确头像属于装饰性图片，或者提供简洁的替代文本。
technicalHints: 如果旁边的客户名称已经表达了相同信息，请使用 alt=""。

reproductionSteps: 打开演示页并检查重点客户头像。
中止图片请求并确认该图片没有可用的 alt 文本。
zh-CN.summary: 图片加载失败时，没有替代文本说明该图片是装饰性的还是具有实际含义。
zh-CN.title: 客户头像没有文本替代内容

technicalHints: Use :focus-visible with a two-pixel outline and offset.

reproductionSteps: Navigate to the demo using only Tab.
Observe focus on the Start checkout review button.
findings.summary: Computed focus styles remove both outline and box shadow, but pixel-difference evidence was not captured in this reference fixture.
findings.title: Interactive elements may not expose a visible focus indicator

remediation.summary: 恢复高对比度的 focus-visible 样式。
technicalHints: 使用 :focus-visible，并设置两像素轮廓和适当的 outline-offset。

reproductionSteps: 只使用 Tab 键在演示页中导航。
观察“开始结账审核”按钮获得焦点时的显示效果。
zh-CN.summary: 计算样式同时移除了轮廓与阴影，但这个参考夹具没有记录像素差异证据。
zh-CN.title: 交互控件可能没有可见的键盘焦点指示

notes: One intentional console error was observed.
观察到一个故意设置的控制台错误。
已执行 12 次确定性的文本替换。
Directionality stress test only; translation quality was not assessed.
仅进行书写方向压力测试；未评估翻译质量。
Expected image request aborts were excluded from failed-request findings.
预期的图片请求中止未计入普通请求失败问题。
No controls were activated or submitted.
未激活或提交任何控件。

zh-CN.title: Northstar 控制台 · RealityCheck 演示
